reports.published_report: Mason Peters is a pure bat-missing lefty arm operating at elite efficiency levels on a brief but dominant A-ball sample. He's striking out 12.7 per 9 innings while walking just 1.6, putting him in the 99th percentile for both strikeout rate and K-BB% among the ValuCast pitcher pool. The hard flaw: this is 44.7 innings on A-ball, and when translated to MLB-equivalent rates his walk rate jumps to 2.7 per 9 while strikeouts fall to 8.5—a much tighter margin that raises questions about whether the command grades hold at higher competition.
